headline: Australia Posts Record Low T20 Score Against England At The Gabba
seoTitle: Australia T20 Cricket Team Posts Record Low Score
metaDescription: The Australian cricket team was dismissed for 108 runs against England at the Gabba, marking the squad's lowest-ever T20 total on home soil.
aiSummaryBullets: Australia was bowled out for 108 runs during the third T20 international match.
This performance represents the lowest T20 total ever recorded by Australia on home ground.
England bowler Jamie Overton secured a career-best performance, taking five wickets for 18 runs.
aiContextParagraph: During the third T20 international match held at the Gabba, the Australian cricket team faced a significant batting collapse against England. The home side was dismissed for a total of 108 runs, a result that stands as the lowest T20 score ever recorded by an Australian side at home. A key contributor to the dismissal was English bowler Jamie Overton, who achieved his best career figures during the match by taking five wickets for 18 runs. Following this performance, England maintained a strong position in the game. This encounter is part of the ongoing T20 international series between the two nations, drawing attention due to the historically low score achieved by the host team in front of a domestic crowd.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent national news outlets, reflecting high interest in significant sporting outcomes within Australian media.
